It is also the primary airport for most of Palm Beach County, serving the suburbs and cities of Boca Raton, Wellington, Boynton Beach, Jupiter, and Palm Beach Gardens. It is the third-busiest airport in the Miami metropolitan area, after Miami International Airport and Fort Lauderdale–Hollywood International Airport.\nThe airport is operated by the Palm Beach County Department of Airports.
